text:
matt.sales: HarborCap's CISO escalated to execs. They won't greenlight the 4-week POC until we confirm: (A) private peering or equivalent secure transit, (B) customer-managed keys + audit proofs, and (C) a hard spend cap for the POC. Need an internal bridge before their CTO call tomorrow.

rina.eng: I can cover network. Quick check: do they need dedicated ExpressRoute or is a temporary site-to-site VPN OK for the POC? ExpressRoute adds lead time but simplifies compliance.

omar.security: BYOK + audit trail is the main ask. Hosted API can't do HSM BYOK today; Dedicated or Private VPC does with KMS integrations. We'll also need to provide redaction policy and access logs (what we store, retention).

lina.revops: Pricing cap: we can set a hard quota on usage for the POC and disable burst autoscale. To give them confidence I can propose a fixed POC fee + credit for any committed post-POC term. Need AE to confirm expected qps and model to size baseline.

ana.se: For legal/compliance they asked for a one-paragraph attestation for key custody and a sample addendum for BYOK. I can draft that if legal okays a standard clause.

noah.cto: If HarborCap is strategic we should prioritize. I'll join the exec bridge. We should prepare a one-pager: summary, risks, mitigation plan, asks, and a single SLAP line we can show execs.

matt.sales: Thanks. I'll own the bridge. Can we commit to owners + deliverables by EOD?

rina.eng: Deliverable: network options doc w/ timelines. ExpressRoute path: 3-4 weeks to validate peer + ASN exchange; temporary VPN path: 24-72h for POC. I'll attach a diagram and sample IP allowlist. ETA 6pm PT.

omar.security: Deliverable: BYOK options + required evidence list (HSM proof, key rotation, key deletion policy, audit log schema). ETA 5pm PT. Also adding questionnaire snippet they sent:

omar.security: ```
Q4: Do you support customer-managed keys (BYOK)? Please describe key lifecycle, HSM attestation, and who can access plaintext.
Q9: What network connectivity options do you support for private traffic? Provide expected lead times.
Q21: Do you retain raw request payloads? If so, what is retention and redaction policy?
```

lina.revops: Deliverable: POC pricing cap proposal + revenue ops approval path. I can propose a flat POC cap + conditional credit toward a 6-month reserved commit. ETA 4pm PT.

ops-bot: Ticket created: NET-7354 (peering evaluation) assigned to network-team. ETA triage 2h.

ana.se: I've pinged legal for BYOK addendum template and will loop them in. They may request escrow or audit rights language; heads-up.

matt.sales: Good. For the SLAP line, propose something simple we can show execs — neutral but clear.

noah.cto: Draft SLAP: "For the duration of the POC we will operate within an agreed resource baseline and target median latency appropriate to the chosen model; additional dedicated capacity with reserved SLAs is available upon mutual agreement."

matt.sales: That should work. Next: schedule internal bridge at 9:30am PT tomorrow — I'll send calendar. If we have the three docs by EOD we can likely avoid a long exec escalation.

rina.eng: I'll drop the IP allowlist and diagram here when ready.

omar.security: I'll attach the BYOK evidence checklist and suggested wording for audit access.

lina.revops: I'll confirm the POC cap numbers after AE sends estimated token/embedding volumes.

matt.sales: AE will share traffic estimates in the thread shortly. Thanks everyone. Closing this thread and will post bridge invite + final one-pager once compiled. :rocket:
